subject: Fictional adult woman whose visible face and bob hairstyle are guided by the attached photograph; a separate adult companion is cropped to a foreground shoulder.
setting: Glass-roofed botanical conservatory potting pavilion during a lightly snowy late afternoon.
event: A seated woman offers a cyanotype postcard across the tabletop toward a companion near the camera.
visual_priorities: Across-table separation with a clearly readable face above tabletop and forearms.
Another adult companion owns the foreground shoulder; the protagonist faces forward.

The attached image guides visible facial and hair appearance of the fictional adult subject.
baseline_prompt_en: Photograph a fictional adult woman trading a hand-printed cyanotype postcard with a seated companion in a glass-roofed botanical conservatory potting pavilion. Use the supplied photograph solely as a visible facial and hair appearance reference: a dark chin-length bob with a wispy center-parted fringe, softly rounded face, brown eyes, and natural lip shape. She wears a forest-green ribbed cardigan over a cream shirt. In this across-the-table portrait, she sits on the far side of a narrow wooden table, with her upper torso and both forearms visible above the tabletop. A folded route map and a half-finished mug of tea rest below her face. The camera looks past another adult companion's softly blurred shoulder in the left foreground toward her clearly focused face, making an over-the-shoulder shot rather than a backward-looking pose by the woman. She faces forward toward the companion beside the lens with a small conversational smile. She offers the cyanotype postcard toward the camera-side companion, her right hand and postcard projecting into the lower foreground while her face remains clear above them. Her right forearm extends across the table from a relaxed bent elbow, and her thumb and index finger grasp the postcard's bottom edge; its deep-blue plant silhouette faces the recipient. Her left forearm rests on the tabletop and her seated torso stays supported by the chair. The offered card hovers a short distance above the near half of the tabletop. A second cyanotype drying on a wire rack, terracotta pots, and softly layered greenhouse plants establish the exchange in a used workshop space. Light snow is visible outdoors through the glass, while late-afternoon side sunlight softened by a translucent blind warms her cheek and the ridges of the cardigan. Keep the portrait legible as one intimate, natural photographic moment.
